zh-CN: 修正软件更新窗口的尺寸与排版：提示按内容收紧，操作按钮置于右下角，更新说明保留独立滚动区域。
设置中的“关于”和“更新”合并为“关于与更新”，集中显示应用版本、软件与固件更新、帮助、许可和诊断。
保留旧更新入口和固件提示的跳转，中英文界面及更新流程保持兼容。
en: Fix the size and layout of software update windows: compact messages, actions at the lower right, and a separate scrolling area for release notes.
Combine About and Updates into About & updates, bringing together the app version, software and firmware updates, help, licenses and diagnostics.
Keep existing update links and firmware notifications working, with compatible Chinese and English interfaces and update behavior.
